response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including C++ (though not exclusively) and large-scale systems (e.g., microservices handling millions of requests). However, his lack of direct experience with C++ as a primary language in recent roles (current stack is TypeScript/Node.js/AI infrastructure) and minimal cloud architecture or DevOps leadership experience raises concerns. His background in leadership (e.g., organizing workshops, founding companies) is promising but not directly aligned with technical leadership of a cloud compute platform.
strengths: Strong foundation in low-latency and high-performance systems (e.g., DLang at Dunnhumby)
Proven ability to scale systems and mentor teams (e.g., Altom Consulting, GISCollective)
Diverse technical expertise across full-stack, embedded, and infrastructure domains
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (primary requirement is 8 years of C++ programming)
No clear production-level cloud architecture or DevOps leadership experience
Minimal evidence of driving large, ambiguous technical projects to completion in a leadership role
